# FQHESphereProductRules

Module: **FQHE** · directory: `FQHE/src/FQHEOnSphere` · binary: `FQHE/src/Programs/FQHEOnSphere/FQHESphereProductRules`

```text
FQHESphereProductRules, version 0.01

Usage: FQHESphereProductRules [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -i, --input-state : vector file that describes the smaller system
    --input-reference : use a file as the definition of the reference state of the input state
    --output-reference : use a file as the definition of the reference state of the output state
    --common-pattern : pattern that has to be shared between the two n-body states
    --added-pattern : additional pattern that has inserted to go from the smaller system to the larger one
    --factor : multiplicative factor to use when going from the smaller system to the larger one (default value = 1)
    --initial-state : use an optional state where some of the components have already been computed, improving computation time
    --symmetrized-basis : use Lz <-> -Lz symmetrized version of the basis (only valid if total-lz=0)
    --inputhuge-basis : use huge Hilbert space support for the input state
    --outputhuge-basis : use huge Hilbert space support for the output state
    --memory : maximum memory (in MBytes) that can allocated for precalculations when using huge mode (default value = 100)

output options:
    -o, --output-file : name of the fused vector that will be generated
    -t, --txt-output : output the vector into a text file

precalculation options:
    --inputload-hilbert : load Hilbert space description from the input file
    --outputload-hilbert : load Hilbert space description from the output file

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
